name: Seamus Carrick
want: see his gang paid in full every Saturday and send money home to Galway
secret: He is not Seamus Carrick: he took a dead man's name after killing a policeman in the New York draft riots.
voice: Galway Irish, singing when he's happy, cursing when he isn't.
description: Fought for the Union with an Irish regiment, then came west with the railroad. His gang would follow him anywhere.
appearance: Red-bearded, broad, a clay pipe and a shovel he uses to make points.
